settings.text: Freezing is the most natural way to preserve the nutrients in fresh, whole ingredients—with no artificial preservatives. Maev Whole Ingredient Food is flash-frozen to lock in essential vitamins, minerals, and proteins, ensuring your dog gets the highest quality nutrition in every meal. Plus, frozen food helps improve dental health by naturally reducing plaque buildup.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Can I thaw the food?
Paragraphe · Yes! While Maev recommends feeding fro…
settings.text: Yes! While Maev recommends feeding frozen, you can definitely thaw your dog's portion to soften the texture if that is preferred. We recommend letting it sit at room temperature for 10–15 minutes before serving.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Maev is human-grade, meaning Maev…
settings.text:
Yes. Maev is human-grade, meaning Maev only sources USDA-certified proteins from USDA-inspected facilities—the same standards required for human food. Additionally, all of Maev’s ingredients undergo a proprietary safety process designed to mitigate any potential pathogens.

Maev works closely with trusted suppliers, accredited testing centers, leading universities, and industry experts to continuously uphold and improve our safety measures.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · What if my dog is a picky eater?
settings.text: What if my dog is a picky eater?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Having a picky eater is hard. With cha…
settings.text: Having a picky eater is hard. With change, some dogs dive right in, while others take their time warming up to something new. If your dog is hesitant, try thawing the food for 10–15 minutes to soften the texture, mixing it with warm water, or adding their favorite treat on top. Maev recommends following the transition guide closely, and you can always reach out to the Maev Experts for additional tips and advice. Give it time—new routines take patience, and we’re here to help every step of the way.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · What is the Purity Award?
Paragraphe · The Clean Label Project® Purity Award …
settings.text: The Clean Label Project® Purity Award recognizes products that go above and beyond standard safety testing. In addition to screening for contaminants like heavy metals, pesticides, glyphosate, phthalates, and bisphenols. They present the award exclusively to products that perform in the top one-third of their category, making it one of the highest standards for product purity.
